latest.text: A new name for the list of things that kill me: Fallen.

diary.text: Blood Moor. Every place is a story, and most end badly.
I had heard the word. Now I have met the Fallen.
So that is what a Corpsefire looks like. Noted.
That is worth a second look back in camp.
That stung less than I feared. Stronger already.
Not my finest hour. Gold lost, pride bruised.
A new name for the list of things that kill me: Fallen.
